a.title: A leaf and an atom, drawn by Kosika
a.summary: A leaf turning light, water and carbon dioxide into food, and a sodium atom with its electrons in shells.

beats.text: Light falls on the leaf and its chloroplasts catch it.
Carbon dioxide goes in, and oxygen bubbles out as the leaf makes sugar.
Sodium has 11 electrons: 2 in the first shell, 8 in the second, 1 in the third.
That lone outer electron is why sodium reacts so readily.
